meta.name: Special form · heuristic · L(1/3)
meta.regime: N = r^e ± s with r and |s| bounded; polynomial representation supplied
meta.rules: Factoring special-form integers; the algebraic representation is an essential input restriction. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
